sourceNotes: PcbFunctionalGroupingContractTest contains guarded measure() branches for representative placement versions 3 through 12. Current named wrappers exist for versions 3 through 9 and 12; no version-specific grouping wrapper for 10 or 11 was found. PcbPocketPackingContractTest explicitly exercises 10 and 11 for all ten roots.
The exact normalized physical hash oracle is PcbCompactnessContractTest.physicalGeometrySha256(layout); assertion messages state that reference x/y and epoch are excluded.

For representative version12, SAVED12_LARGEST_VOID is declared as the published12 comparator used by the later version13 path; the v12 representative caller computes/prints whitespace but does not compare it. Holdout version12 compares its SAVED12_HOLDOUT_LARGEST_VOID exactly.
Cases with no exact hash literal on a conditional branch are explicitly marked; no replacement or derived hash is supplied.
